convertibility_reason: Uses only candlestick pattern recognition (no indicators) with fixed SL/TP and simple market order execution. No external libraries, no custom indicators, no complex money management.

other_exits: SL and TP only - no signal-based early exit

custom_logic_notes: Bullish Engulfing: previous bar is bearish (close<open) AND current bar is bullish (close>open) AND current open<=previous close AND current close>=previous open AND previous open>current open AND previous close<current close. Bearish Engulfing: previous bar is bullish (close>open) AND current bar is bearish (close<open) AND current open>=previous close AND current close<=previous open AND previous open<current open AND previous close>current close. Pattern detection uses completed bar [1] vs current forming bar [0]. SL is placed at the low of the engulfing candle body for longs, high of the engulfing candle body for shorts.
python_conversion_notes: Pure candlestick pattern recognition - no indicator handles needed. Implement pattern detection on completed bars (shift=1 vs shift=2 for previous vs previous-previous). SL/TP are set as absolute price levels derived from candle body extremes (low of signal candle for long SL, high for short SL), not pip offsets. Verify position count before entry. New bar detection required to avoid repeated signals within same bar.
